Azure DevOps Engineer, Dream11
Sep 2025 - Present
At Dream11 I implemented CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation to support feature releases for the fantasy sports platform. Built and maintained Terraform modules to provision standardized Azure resource groups, virtual networks and AKS clusters, reducing environment setup time by ~60%. Managed Kubernetes deployments for microservices with Helm charts and automated rollouts and rollbacks, improving deployment success rate. Used Docker to containerize services and integrated image builds into pipeline. Collaborated with development teams via Jira and Git workflows to adopt Agile practices and streamline release planning. Implemented monitoring and alerting on Azure for cluster health and application metrics.

Skills: Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Jira, Git, Agile
